text:
marta: heads up — nightly found OOMs in the new quant-splitter path on small-A100 shards (staging).
jon: seen the heap traces? can you paste the tail of the failing job logs?
marta: pasted: ```
[2026-03-20T03:12:14Z] oom: alloc failed 1.2GiB during matmul_shard_split
stack: runtime::kv_cache::reserve -> matmul::shard_split_v3
```
kevin: ugh. that shard-splitting heuristic v3 is the one we shipped yesterday with kernel 3.8.2, right?
marta: yeah, quant build Q-14 + kernel 3.8.2. nightly runs with full batch=64 reproduce.
deploybot: started rollout: kernel=3.8.2, runtime=engine-20260318, percent=5% (canary) — id: rb-4765432100
jon: canary metrics are fine until memory peaks; looks like it only surfaces on shard-local splits when sequence_len>2048.
kevin: my proposal: pin engine nodes in us-east-1 to kernel 3.8.1 and hold the regional canary while we bisect. low blast radius.
marta: +1 to pin. we should also add a quick smoke that hits seq_len 3072 and batch 64 to validate the pin.
sre-bot: /pin region=us-east-1 kernel=3.8.1 ttl=6h by=kevin — OK queued
deploybot: pinned 12 pools in us-east-1 to kernel=3.8.1 (ttl 6h). rollback policy untouched.
vivek: do we need a hotfix kernel patch or revert quant-splitter change? bisect task assigned to @sasha and me.
sasha: started bisect: disabling shard_split_v3 -> fall back to v2 on a staging pool. will report by EOD.
lee: release-notes bullet: "Mitigation: regional pin to kernel 3.8.1 due to shard-splitting OOM in quant path; investigating" — shall I add?
jon: add "affects large-context workloads on small GPUs" and note canary paused.
lee: will add.
marta: checklist for roll decision: 1) confirm bisect reproduces 2) confirm small-A100 smoke ok with v2 3) perf regression check for v2 fallback 4) decide between patch vs revert
kevin: perf regression check: schedule 2x perf runs on staging; if v2 fallback <3% tail-latency regress, we can revert splitter in next patch.
jon: also add telemetry delta alert for KV cache growth — tweak alert thresholds so we don't flood on the pin.
sre-bot: alert thresholds updated for kv-cache-growth in us-east-1 (silenced for 1h).
sasha: bisect note: when I flip to v2 on a staging shard, memory stabilizes in 6 minutes. capturing full trace now.
marta: thanks. once we have trace + perf numbers let's decide. if we revert, we need a deploybot plan: unpin -> release with kernel 3.8.1->3.8.3 (patch) OR just flip splitter flag via rollout config.
kevin: prefer flag flip (faster) if it passes canary. will prepare rollout config with `splitter.enable_v3=false` and guarded by model-size tag.
lee: I drafted a short release-note blurb and will drop into the changelog PR after final call.
marta: final ask: @deploybot — keep the us-east-1 pin until 12:00 UTC tomorrow or until we explicitly unpin.
deploybot: updated pin ttl to 12:00 UTC 2026-03-21 for us-east-1 kernel=3.8.1 per request.
vivek: pinging infra for a quick kernel-rebase test matrix if we need a 3.8.3 patch.
j on: thanks all — will regroup in 2h with bisect results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
